# Season Shelf 1.2.9

- Restored MCF helper discovery, including Sinhala and rich-message menus, season and quality selection, and private episode deliveries. Existing helper chats now appear in the series source list.
- Added clear expired-search messages with a fresh-search recovery path, late-delivery checks, and guidance when temporary files are deleted.
- Removed duplicated menu options and added Back navigation to the app's search setup screens. Filters, drafts and scroll positions are retained; the first dialog shows only Close.
- Added an optional Windows shutdown after downloads finish, including verification and file transfers. A 60-second countdown can be cancelled from any page. The option is off by default and resets when the app exits.
- Strengthened account isolation: new sign-ins require fresh Telegram authentication, workspace history follows the verified account, and signing out removes the local session and requests Telegram revocation.
- Tightened credential storage, installer exclusions and release asset filtering, and added automated secret scanning.

Windows installations can update from within the app. On macOS, download the universal DMG and replace the app in Applications. Builds remain unsigned, and the macOS build is not notarized.

MCF menus and delivery messages are controlled by the bots and can expire. Request a fresh search or season when necessary. Automatic shutdown is available on Windows only.
